messages.subject: Project Ember — draft sale contract v1
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Elena,

Please find attached the first draft of the sale contract for Ashby House, incorporating the SCPC (Third Edition — 2018 Revision). Key commercial points reflect the heads: price £24.75m, 10% deposit as stakeholder, 20 working days to completion, TOGC, and a service-charge retention.

Look forward to your mark-up.

Rachel Voss
Associate | Pendle Voss LLP

Rachel,

James
